import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] a = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] b = new char[20][20];
    static Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static int[][] Dis = new int[20][20];
    static int[][][][] dis = new int[11][11][11][11];
    static int[] fx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] fy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, fl, c, n;
        Edge(int u, int v, int fl, int c, int n) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.fl = fl;
            this.c = c;
            this.n = n;
        }
    }
    
    static Edge[] e = new Edge[200005];
    static int cnt, head[], p[], v[], s = 501, t = 502, ans, n, m, dep[];
    
    static void add(int u, int v, int w) {
        e[++cnt] = new Edge(u, v, 0, w, head[u]);
        head[u] = cnt;
        e[++cnt] = new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = cnt;
    }
    
    static boolean Find() {
        Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
            v[i] = dep[i] = 0;
        }
        queue.push(s);
        v[s] = 1;
        dep[s] = 1;
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int x = queue.poll();
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = e[i].n) {
                if (v[e[i].v] == 0 && e[i].fl < e[i].c) {
                    p[e[i].v] = i;
                    queue.push(e[i].v);
                    v[e[i].v] = 1;
                    dep[e[i].v] = dep[x] + 1;
                    if (e[i].v == t) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static int dfs(int x, int now) {
        if (x == t || now == 0) {
            return now;
        }
        int total = now;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = e[i].n) {
            if (e[i].c > e[i].fl && dep[e[i].v] == dep[x] + 1) {
                int delta = dfs(e[i].v, Math.min(total, e[i].c - e[i].fl));
                if (delta == 0) {
                    dep[e[i].v] = 0;
                }
                e[i].fl += delta;
                e[((i - 1) ^ 1) + 1].fl -= delta;
                total -= delta;
                if (total == 0) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return now - total;
    }
    
    static void dinic() {
        while (Find()) {
            ans += dfs(s, 1000000007);
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        m = scanner.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                Dis[i][j] = 10000;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    Dis[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (a[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(s, (i - 1) * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] front = q.poll();
            int x = front[0], y = front[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + fx[i], ny = y + fy[i];
                if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && a[nx][ny] <= '9' && Dis[nx][ny] > Dis[x][y] + 1) {
                    Dis[nx][ny] = Dis[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] > '9') continue;
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        dis[i][j][k][l] = 10000;
                    }
                }
                q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                dis[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] front = q.poll();
                    int x = front[0], y = front[1];
                    for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                        int nx = x + fx[f], ny = y + fy[f];
                        if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && a[nx][ny] <= '9' && 
                            dis[i][j][nx][ny] > dis[i][j][x][y] + 1 && dis[i][j][x][y] < Dis[x][y]) {
                            dis[i][j][nx][ny] = dis[i][j][x][y] + 1;
                            q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        if (dis[i][j][k][l] <= Math.min(Dis[k][l], m)) {
                            add((i - 1) * n + j, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (b[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add((i - 1) * n + j + 100, 502, b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        dinic();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
